verdict.rationale: Fathom ships its own REST API with SDKs and an MCP server. The API covers reading meetings, transcripts, summaries, recording downloads, teams, team members and users, plus creating and deleting webhooks. However, the documented surface is mostly read and poll, and many UI features advertised on the pricing page have no documented API equivalent, so UI parity is far from shown. Missing for 10: API coverage of comments, folders, playlists, clips, keyword alerts, AI scorecards, Deal View, CRM field sync, custom summaries and recording/bot settings; write/mutation endpoints for meeting content; any parity statement or published OpenAPI spec (probe 404s).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
